about: Variation presets of prompt_menu (Jake 2026-10-10: 'all variations … writing a prompt in this style, choosing different options (skills, images, research etc.) for both Claude and ChatGPT'). A preset = params (+ default beats) merged UNDER the overlay's own fields (fields win). 'items': 'kit' = the app's REAL rows of the chosen menu (kit menu_source). Options come from ui-kits/<app>/options.json (mapped 2026-10-10). 'chip.thumb_src': 'asset:<file>' = a produced asset the planner inlines as a data: URI (never invented).

params_added.menu: bool, default true. false = composer only (typing a prompt, then the cursor clicks send)
params_added.prompt: string ≤ 220 chars typed after the pick (or alone with menu:false) at the measured motion4 typing (71 cps, eased, solid caret)
params_added.chip: {kind: 'tool' (default with a kit chip) | 'image' | 'file' | 'indicator' | 'none', name?, thumb_src?, color?, bg?, style?}: how the pick shows in the composer
params_added.preview: bool: grey '/<row>' preview while hovering (reference neutral box: true; real apps: false)
